scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students

conditions.raw_text: Candidate must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category of the state.
Candidate must have successfully completed 10th standard (Matriculation) from a recognized secondary education board.
Amended: Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 per annum (increased from Rs. 2,50,000).

documents.raw_text: Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority.
Income Certificate valid for current financial year.
Bank passbook copy seeded with Aadhaar number.

benefits.raw_text: full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable academic tuition fees
Amended: increased monthly maintenance allowance of Rs. 1500 for hostellers
Amended: increased monthly maintenance allowance of Rs. 650 for day scholars

exclusions.raw_text: Students who are employed ... are not eligible under this scheme.
Students ... availing any other government scholarship or stipend are not eligible under this scheme.
